assumptions: Published generic round/stretch circuits can be exported and verified for arbitrary chaining state without hidden specialization or extra phase/ancilla assumptions.
Each clean block preserves original message and previous chaining state; expand schedule, run64 rounds, add8 preserved input words modulo2^32, then reverse the schedule.
Use the unoptimized textbook7T Toffoli mapping only for added feedforward; optimize neither across block nor across forward/reverse boundaries.
All intermediate chaining states and required message material are retained until full inverse. No free erase or unaccounted regeneration.
Target comparison, search reflection, challenge/noise/field transcript construction, memory preparation, routing and error correction are excluded.

full_iteration_model: T_iter = T_F + T_F_inverse + T_threshold + T_reflection(k); for a chosen symmetric unitary implementation only, T_F_inverse=T_F. Successful search iteration count is conditional on actual valid-input marked fraction and coherent search space.
unknowns: Export/test arbitrary-IV clean SHA compression with exact gate/ancilla/phase semantics.
Reversible bounded rejection sampler including128-hash cap per label and compaction; not a classical expected loop count.
Reversible canonical field arithmetic mod4294967291, transcript generation, and allowed task preprocessing/reassociation.
Whether message words are retained or generated on demand and every checkpoint recomputation cost.
Target comparator, search-register width, finite nonce space, aborted searches and competing block arrivals.
Optimized quantum algorithm and true effective accepted-work rate relative to honest production hardware.
Physical noise model, layout/routing, code distances, magic-state factories, full-run failure budget and classical feedback.

sources.title: Amy et al., Estimating the cost of generic quantum pre-image attacks on SHA-2 and SHA-3 (SAC 2016, revised 2016-11-30)
sources.verified: One 512-bit block and initialized constants. Optimized round 3020 T / T-depth1100; stretch744 T / T-depth372. Published full core228992 T, T-depth70400,2402 logical qubits. Their specific phase oracle doubles the core plus equality marking; their diffusion adds separate cost.

sources.title: NIST FIPS 180-4, Secure Hash Standard
sources.verified: SHA-256 uses512-bit message blocks, padding1 then zeroes to448 mod512 then64-bit length; multi-block chaining includes feedforward.

sources.title: Cuccaro, Draper, Kutin, Moulton, A new quantum ripple-carry addition circuit
sources.verified: Addition modulo2^n for n>=3 uses2n-3 Toffoli and one clean ancilla; no overflow output.

sources.title: Gidney, Halving the cost of quantum addition, Quantum2,74(2018)
sources.verified: Textbook Toffoli uses7 T; temporary logical-AND uses4 T to compute and0 T for measurement-based erase under its conditions. Thus reversing a circuit is not always the most economical clean-up design.

sources.title: Bennett, Time/space trade-offs for reversible computation, SIAM J Comput18(4)(1989)
sources.verified: Checkpoint/pebbling gives reversible time-space tradeoffs while retaining input. It does not give W1-specific optimized checkpoint counts.

sources.title: Beverland et al., Assessing requirements to scale to practical quantum advantage
sources.verified: Physical-resource conversion requires logical depths/counts, acceptable total failure, code choice/distance, physical gate/measurement assumptions and factory throughput; classical control and noise assumptions remain explicit.
